# Generated WebP regression fixtures

Original, programmatically generated test imagery; no user or third-party artwork.
Created with official libwebp 1.6.0 Windows x64 tools:
- `lossless.webp`: lossless encoding of the 100x60 solid-color BMP fixture.
- `lossy.webp`: quality 85 encoding of color study A (1600x1000).
- `alpha.webp`: lossless encoding of the 16x16 transparent PNG fixture.
- `large.webp`: lossless encoding of the 8192x256 solid-color PNG fixture.
- `frame-a.webp` / `frame-b.webp`: lossless encodings of color studies A and B.
- `animated.webp`: `webpmux -frame frame-a.webp +100+0+0+0 -frame frame-b.webp +100+0+0+0 -loop 0`.

The corresponding PNG/BMP artwork is generated by `CreateFixtures` in `tests/Tests.cs`.
